name: universal-agent-platform
description: Self-hosted Hermes agent operations; commercial platform foundation in development.

scripts.dev: npm run dev -w server & npm run dev -w web
scripts.build: npm run build -w web && npm run build -w server
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w server && npm run typecheck -w web
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build && npm run audit:branding && npm run audit:rights && npm run audit:contracts
scripts.repro:build: node scripts/reproducible-build.mjs --install-cmd "npm ci --no-audit --no-fund" --build-cmd "npm run build" --output-dir web/dist --out artifacts/reproducible/web && node scripts/reproducible-build.mjs --install-cmd "npm ci --no-audit --no-fund" --build-cmd "npm run build" --output-dir server/dist --out artifacts/reproducible/server
